a 3-for-1 forward share split for the WisdomTree Japan Hedged Equity Fund

The split will apply to shareholders of record as of the close of markets on Oct. 7, 2026, payable after the close of the markets on October 8, 2026. DXJ will begin trading at its split-adjusted price on Oct. 9.
The move will increase the number of shares outstanding while lowering the fund’s per-share price.

title: WisdomTree sets 3-for-1 forward split for Japan Hedged Equity Fund
